claims: Transfuse red blood cells for severe anemia (hemoglobin 7.1 g/dL) in the setting of active bleeding risk and coagulopathy.
Reverse coagulopathy with vitamin K and/or fresh frozen plasma given INR 4.1 and PTT 67.6 sec.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR, PTT, platelets) closely given severe coagulopathy and thrombocytopenia.
Obtain blood cultures and other sepsis workup if not already done.
Evaluate and manage severe hyperbilirubinemia (total bilirubin 21.4 mg/dL).
Treat hyperkalemia (potassium 4.8–5.2 mEq/L) and hyperphosphatemia (phosphate 7.7 mg/dL) in the setting of acute kidney injury (creatinine 3.3–3.6 mg/dL, BUN 75 mg/dL).
Continue lung-protective mechanical ventilation with PEEP and low tidal volumes, monitoring plateau pressures.
Monitor and manage hypotension (MAP 44–53 mmHg) with vasopressor support as needed.
Monitor and manage hyperglycemia (glucose 188–310 mg/dL) with insulin therapy.
